name: agent-orch
description: Task branches and explicit cross-chat handoff with owner fencing, independently accepted delivery, recoverable pending merges and bounded workspaces.

interface.shortDescription: Hand off tasks, review changes, commit and merge safely.
interface.longDescription: Audit the original project, recommend current model routes and task branches, and transfer task authority explicitly across chats without rewriting Plans. Independently review and accept exact changes, commit to protected task refs, release recoverable workspaces before merge, and integrate parallel results with fresh evidence. Keep commit, merge and cleanup states separate in the local Auditor. Share limits across project copies: three Worker and five total auxiliary workspaces by default. Preserve existing routes, unrelated edits and historical records; unknown drift needs review. Hooks do not wake idle chats.
defaultPrompt: Audit this project, recommend models and a task branch, and initialize approved Git policies while preserving existing work.
Continue this task through an explicit cross-chat handoff, keeping its Plan, worker session and evidence.
Implement and independently review this task, commit exact accepted changes, merge under policy and safely retire workspaces.
